verdict.rationale: The product controls the whole phone OS rather than one walled app. It drives iOS through an ESP32 acting as a hardware mouse via AssistiveTouch, and the docs show the agent leaving its own app to open Clock, type the time and save. However, this is iPhone/iOS control, not desktop applications, and keyboard shortcuts are not evidenced. missing for 10: control of desktop (computer) applications, keyboard-shortcut support, independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-app reliability.
